_comment: Embedding-model pin. The reproducibility seed: a rebuild re-pulls the exact Ollama digest and asserts it; every memory row stamps embed_model so a model swap is detectable.

ollama_embed_options._why: Ollama /api/embed silently truncates at ~512 unless num_ctx is set explicitly (ollama/ollama#7008). Root cause of the historical 'nomic 2048 cap' bug. ALWAYS send these.

primary._digest_history: Re-pinned 2026-07-17 : bge-m3:latest was re-pulled on the embedding host on 2026-07-11 (modified_at 2026-07-11T22:12:57+04:00), which recomputed the manifest digest 7907646426070047a77226ac3e684fbbe8410524f7b4a74d02837e43f2146bab -> b5ebf672121b4b1229f200288e45a7420802c0a161312004546c2af020521c66 (size +88 B). Same weights: param_size 566.70M, quant F16, dim 1024, ctx 8192 all unchanged -> existing 1024-dim embeddings stay valid, NO re-embed needed. Manifest-level change only. Original pin (2026-06-29) digest preserved in this note.
primary._note: No asymmetric prefix required (lowest-footgun). Only the DENSE vector is used; keyword side = Postgres FTS.

challenger._note: Same dim (1024) as primary -> A/B swappable in the vector(1024) column with zero schema change. Mind the query-side Instruct prefix (omitting costs ~1-5% recall; index/query usage must match).

decision: Build on bge-m3. Big Step 2 benchmarks both on the golden-query set against today's recall baseline; the winner becomes the final pin. Verified 2026-06-29: both embed at 1024-dim with num_ctx=8192.
